speaker: Doctor
text: I am examining a newborn presenting with respiratory distress. Can you describe the specific nature of the distress, such as the onset timing, presence of grunting, or cyanosis?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the infant exhibit grunting, nasal flaring, or subcostal retractions, and has a chest X-ray been performed to evaluate for ground-glass opacities or air bronchograms? REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray
